metadata.description: Realistic pharmaceutical supply chain route templates for India
sources: Department of Pharmaceuticals, Government of India — pharma cluster survey
CDSCO (Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation) public alerts
GS1 India supply chain visibility study 2022
Bureau of Pharma PSUs of India (BPPI/PMBI) Jan Aushadhi distribution data
Universal Immunization Programme cold chain assessment reports
National Cold Chain & Vaccine Management Resource Centre (NCCVMRC) data
metadata.notes: Transit times are [min_days, max_days]. Distances are approximate road distances. Risk levels: low, medium, high, critical.

monsoon.description: Southwest monsoon causes flooding, road damage, and port delays. Transportation time increases by 30-40% in affected regions.
heavily_affected_routes: Any route through Mumbai (severe urban flooding)
Coastal routes along western India (Goa, Konkan, Kerala)
Routes through Assam and NE states (Brahmaputra flooding)
Any route requiring JNPT port (Mumbai port congestion)
moderately_affected_routes: Routes through eastern UP and Bihar
Routes through Odisha and West Bengal
Routes through Tamil Nadu (October-December NE monsoon instead)

winter_fog.description: Dense fog across the Indo-Gangetic plain reduces visibility and causes highway pile-ups. Road transport slows by 20-30%.
heavily_affected_routes: Routes through Punjab, Haryana, and western UP
Routes on NH-2 (Grand Trunk Road through UP/Bihar)
Routes through Lucknow, Kanpur, Varanasi corridor

diwali_season.description: 20-30% spike in OTC drug demand. Logistics congestion due to festival freight rush.

summer_season.description: Heat-related illness increases demand for ORS, electrolytes, and cold chain drugs face higher spoilage risk.

flu_season.description: Surge in demand for antibiotics, antivirals, and antipyretics.

remote_area.description: Routes to NE states, tribal areas, or areas with poor road connectivity

cross_border.description: International routes with customs and border delays

routes.notes: One of India's busiest pharma corridors. NH-48 connects Ahmedabad to Mumbai. Zydus, Torrent supply chains.
Major north-south corridor. Passes through Rajasthan. Bhagirath Palace is the end distribution point.
NH-48 to Udaipur then NH-8 to Jaipur corridor. Gujarat pharma serves western Rajasthan.
Connects Gujarat manufacturing to central India. NH-47 through Godhra-Dahod corridor.
Short intra-Gujarat route. Alembic Pharma (Vadodara) supplies southern Gujarat.
API corridor from Ankleshwar GIDC to Pune's pharma distribution network.
Long cross-country route via Mumbai-Pune-Bangalore-Chennai. Often uses multimodal transport.
Long east-west route. Passes through UP Gangetic plain. Susceptible to both monsoon and winter fog.
Major bulk drug corridor. Dr. Reddy's, Aurobindo supply chains. NH-44 (longest national highway).
Hyderabad API manufacturers supply Mumbai's export and domestic distribution hubs.
South-eastern corridor. Aurobindo, Hetero supply chains to Tamil Nadu.
Deccan corridor connecting two major pharma hubs. NH-44 route.
Cross-country route through Odisha corridor. Serves eastern India and NE gateway.
Intra-region route. Hyderabad bulk drug capital to Vizag pharma SEZ and export hub.
Hyderabad to Kerala via Bengaluru. Kerala has high pharma literacy and consumption.
Highest-volume north India route. Baddi cluster (500+ units) to Bhagirath Palace Delhi. Landslide risk on Chandigarh-Baddi stretch.
Short route from Baddi cluster via Chandigarh to Punjab. Cipla, Mankind supply chains.
Baddi to UP heartland via Delhi bypass. Critical for UP's 230M+ population. Winter fog on NH-44.
Satellite Baddi cluster to nearest Haryana distribution hub.
Cross-border Himachal-Uttarakhand route. Mountainous terrain, landslide prone.
Mumbai-Pune Expressway. Highest traffic pharma corridor in Maharashtra.
Reverse flow from Mumbai HQ to Gujarat distribution. Sun Pharma, Cipla corporate supply.
Central Maharashtra corridor. Wockhardt, Lupin supply from Aurangabad MIDC.
Konkan coastal route. Higher demand during tourist season (Oct-Feb).
API supply from Tarapur MIDC to central India via Nashik-Dhule corridor.
South India's busiest pharma corridor. Biocon, Strides supply chains. NH-48.
Western Ghats route through Mysuru-Wayanad or Salem corridor. Monsoon landslides possible.
East coast route via Anantapur. Connects Karnataka biopharma to AP pharma SEZ.
East coast to west coast south India route. Through Madurai or Salem-Coimbatore.
East coast corridor via Nellore-Vizag-Berhampur. Cyclone disruption risk Oct-Dec.
Intra-TN route. Sanofi, Orchid Pharma supply chains to western Tamil Nadu.
Patanjali, Dabur supply route from SIDCUL Haridwar to NCR markets.
Mankind Pharma, Torrent supply from Pantnagar IIE to UP heartland.
Mountain to plain route. Sun Pharma, Cipla Sikkim units. NH-10 prone to landslides. Siliguri corridor bottleneck.
Sanofi, Glenmark Goa units supply to Karnataka via NH-748.
Delhi NCR hub redistributing to western UP. Meerut is a secondary distribution node.
Delhi hub to Punjab. NH-44 Grand Trunk Road. Winter fog causes major delays.
Delhi NCR satellite distribution. Gurugram C&F agents serve NCR and Haryana.
Delhi hub redistribution to western Rajasthan. Thar Desert area, sparse pharmacy network.
Mumbai hub redistributing to Goa. Konkan route affected by monsoon.
Mumbai to central India via Nagpur redistribution hub. Serves MP tribal districts.
Mumbai distribution to Saurashtra region of Gujarat.
Kolkata hub redistribution to Bihar. Bihar is a known counterfeit hotspot with weak regulatory oversight.
Kolkata hub to Jharkhand. Serves tribal areas with limited healthcare infrastructure.
Siliguri corridor (Chicken's Neck) is the only land route to NE India. Bottleneck causes delays and creates counterfeit entry points.
NE hub redistribution. Shillong depends entirely on Guwahati supply chain.
Guwahati to Nagaland. Remote area, weak regulation, limited cold chain. NH-29 is only route.
Guwahati to isolated Tripura via Silchar. Near Bangladesh border. Drug diversion risk.
Chennai hub to AP capital region. NH-16 east coast corridor.
Intra-Telangana route. Hyderabad bulk drug cluster to tier-2 city Warangal.
Hyderabad to Rayalaseema region. Serves pilgrimage city with high transient population.
Long route to eastern UP. Varanasi is key distribution point for eastern UP and northern Bihar.
Long supply chain through Delhi to Bihar. Multiple intermediaries increase counterfeit risk. Bihar has weak drug regulation.
Bengaluru via Coimbatore to northern Kerala. Palakkad Gap is the route through Western Ghats.
Intra-MP route. Pithampur manufacturing (IPCA, Lupin) to state capital.
Baddi to J&K via Chandigarh. NH-44 to Jammu. Mountain terrain, winter closures possible.
Kolkata to North Bengal. Siliguri is gateway to NE states, Sikkim, Darjeeling, and Nepal border.
Bhagirath Palace is Asia's largest pharma wholesale market. Known counterfeit distribution point. Unverified manufacturers supply through here.
Noida-Ghaziabad belt has unregistered pharma units producing counterfeits distributed via Bhagirath Palace to UP.
Faridabad has dubious pharma units. Products flow through Bhagirath Palace to Bihar, which has minimal drug inspection capacity.
Modi Nagar is a known hub for illicit pharma manufacturing. Night-time production operations. Distributed through Delhi grey market.
Bhagirath Palace wholesale distribution to smaller Rajasthan cities with less regulatory oversight.
Kanpur is a known counterfeit risk area. High-volume unverified wholesale distribution from Bhagirath Palace.
India-Bangladesh border. Massive illegal pharma trade. Phensedyl smuggling is a multi-crore industry. Petrapole is busiest land border.
Northern Bangladesh border. Less patrolled crossing points. River-based smuggling routes.
Open India-Nepal border. No passport required. Major transit point for pharmaceutical smuggling. Bardibas storage facilities.
Raxaul-Birgunj is the busiest India-Nepal trade point. Pharma drugs smuggled both directions. Virtually no inspection.
Agartala-Akhaura border. Significant pharma smuggling to Bangladesh. BSF patrols but porous.
Remote NE route. Single NH-2 through mountains. Insurgency zones. Drug diversion to Myanmar border.
Most remote pharma supply route. Mizoram borders Myanmar and Bangladesh. Extreme terrain. Cold chain impossible to maintain.
West Bengal is identified as a major counterfeit drug hotspot. Rural areas have minimal pharmacist oversight.
Routes to tribal areas with very weak regulatory oversight. Limited pharmacy infrastructure. Counterfeit drugs go undetected.
Bastar is remote tribal region with Maoist insurgency. Drug supply disrupted frequently. No supply chain verification possible.
Bharat Biotech, Biological E vaccine supply from Genome Valley to Delhi GMSD. Requires reefer trucks. 2-8°C maintenance critical.
Vaccine corridor to Mumbai GMSD. Well-maintained reefer infrastructure on this route.
South India vaccine corridor. Chennai GMSD serves Tamil Nadu and Kerala.
Long cold chain route to Kolkata GMSD. High spoilage risk. Power outages in eastern India compromise cold storage.
Biocon biosimilar distribution. Western Ghats crossing complicates cold chain. Monsoon landslides.
Serum Institute of India (Pune) vaccine supply to northern India. Critical national immunization route.
Longest vaccine cold chain route in India. Serum Institute to NE India. Extremely high spoilage risk. Siliguri corridor bottleneck.
Gujarat biotech (Zydus, Claris) insulin supply to Rajasthan. Summer heat (45°C+) challenges cold chain.
Critical cold chain for UP's 230M+ population. Only 1 cold chain point per 100K people in UP. Frequent power outages.
Mountain cold chain route. Panacea Biotec vaccine supply. Altitude and road conditions challenge temperature maintenance.
Bihar has among the worst cold chain infrastructure in India. Jharkhand and Bihar have 1 CCP per 100K population. High vaccine wastage.
Serum Institute vaccines to MP. MP has sub-optimal cold chain points. JE vaccine for endemic districts. Last-mile delivery to rural CHCs.
Jan Aushadhi scheme. PMBI procures from WHO-GMP manufacturers. 50-90% cheaper than branded. Gujarat has strong Jan Aushadhi network.
Jan Aushadhi for UP (2210 stores, highest in India). MSME supplier stockouts have been a persistent issue. L-1 bidding system.

common_drugs: UIP vaccines (BCG, OPV, Pentavalent, MR, Rotavirus, PCV)
routes.notes: National Immunization Programme. Serum Institute supplies to GMSD Delhi. GMSD then distributes to state vaccine stores across North India.
Bharat Biotech/Biological E vaccine supply to GMSD Chennai for South Indian states distribution.
GMSD Kolkata serves WB, Bihar, Jharkhand, Odisha, and NE states. One of four national vaccine depots.
Serum Institute to GMSD Mumbai. Serves Maharashtra, Gujarat, Goa, MP, Rajasthan vaccine distribution.
Central Government Health Scheme. Serves central govt employees and pensioners. Strict procurement from approved list.
Employees State Insurance scheme. Serves organized sector workers. High volume, lowest-bid procurement.
Tamil Nadu Medical Services Corporation model. Gold standard for state govt drug procurement. Transparent tendering, robust quality checks.
Mission Indradhanush targets pockets of low immunization coverage. 90% target coverage. District-level cold chain points within 60min of session sites.
